notes: County 'Election Information and Results' page (Umbraco /media/ files) posts, per election, an unofficial summary and an unofficial 'Precinct by Precinct' report, then official ones. No Clarity link. Every file's server Last-Modified is in August 2026 (for example Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:38:28 GMT for the 2024 file; Mon, 10 Aug 2026 for the 2026 files), which reflects a later re-upload or site move, so the server gives no election-night upload evidence. The printed report times and PDF CreationDates of the unofficial precinct reports are all on election night: 2024 general 'Precinct Summary - 11/05/2024 9:55 PM' (scan CreationDate 2024-11-06 04:01 UTC); 2026 primary 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT REPULICAN - 03/03/2026 10:08 PM' (CreationDate 2026-03-04 04:11 UTC); 2026 runoff 'UNOFFICIAL REPUBLICAN RESULTS - 05/26/2026 9:31 PM' (scan CreationDate 2026-05-27 02:47 UTC). Each election has a single unofficial precinct report. Results are END on printed run time only (low); check 3 could confirm the posting time. Scanned files read visually. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): 2024_general END to UNDETERMINED (precinct report 2024-general-precint-by-precinct-unofficial-results.pdf uploaded 2026-08-12 10:38 CT; printed 2024-11-05 21:55 CT); night_updates_with_precinct_numbers cleared; 2026_primary END to UNDETERMINED (precinct report precinct-by-precinct-republican.pdf uploaded 2026-08-10 14:06 CT; printed 2026-03-03 22:08 CT); night_updates_with_precinct_numbers cleared; 2026_runoff END to UNDETERMINED (precinct report precinct-by-precinct-republican.pdf uploaded 2026-08-10 09:25 CT; printed 2026-05-26 21:31 CT); night_updates_with_precinct_numbers cleared; tag PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT to UNKNOWN. Check 3 pending for the elections changed to UNDETERMINED.
tag_rationale: After Rule 47: 2024_general UNDETERMINED, 2026_primary UNDETERMINED, 2026_runoff UNDETERMINED. No election is determined, so the rule gives UNKNOWN with confidence low.
